content:
## Requirement review

| Requirement | Code coverage | Test coverage | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lowercase the scheme and host | `src/UrlShortener.Application/Links/UrlNormalizer.cs`: `Normalize` lowercases the scheme and `NormalizeAuthority` lowercases the host. `LinkService.CreateAsync` calls the normalizer before constructing the `ShortLink` sent to `TryCreateAsync`. | `UrlNormalizationAcceptanceTests.NormalizeLowercasesSchemeAndHostRemovesHttpDefaultPortAndUtmParameters`; `UrlNormalizationTests.CreateNormalizesSchemeHostDefaultPortAndUtmParameters`; integration test `UrlNormalizationPersistenceTests.CreationPersistsNormalizedUrlAndUsesItInResponseDetailsAndRedirect`. | Covered, including the create/persistence path. |
| Remove default ports | `UrlNormalizer.NormalizeAuthority` removes an explicit port when it matches the HTTP or HTTPS default; it retains other ports. | Unit tests cover HTTP `:80`, HTTPS `:443`, and retention of `:8443`. | Covered. |
| Strip `utm_` tracking parameters before saving | `UrlNormalizer.IsUtmParameter` checks the decoded parameter name case-insensitively. `LinkService.CreateAsync` normalizes the request before passing its URL to `TryCreateAsync`. | Unit tests cover multiple UTM parameters, mixed casing, an encoded underscore, and preservation of unrelated parameters. `UrlNormalizationPersistenceTests` verifies the normalized value in the database, API details, and redirect. | Covered. |
| Preserve idempotency behavior while normalizing | `LinkService.CreateAsync` computes the request hash before replacing the destination with its normalized form. | `UrlNormalizationAcceptanceTests.CreatePersistsNormalizedDestinationAndHashesOriginalRequest` and `UrlNormalizationTests.CreateKeepsIdempotencyHashBasedOnOriginalRequest`. | Covered and consistent with the stated design. |
| Document the behavior | The supplied docs artifact describes normalization, API behavior, limitations, and idempotency. | No documentation test is shown; the supplied host evidence only says JSON and file boundaries were validated. | Content is consistent, but `docs/features/url-normalization.md` is not present in `currentFiles`, so its inclusion as a changed file cannot be confirmed. |

## Gaps and risks

- Confirm that `docs/features/url-normalization.md` was actually added to the repository. Its content appears in `docs.json`, but the stated path is absent from the complete `currentFiles` list.
- The supplied host evidence reports `dotnet build` succeeded and `dotnet test` had 100 passed, 0 failed, and 0 skipped. These are host-supplied results, not independently verified here.

Verdict: FAIL — Add or confirm `docs/features/url-normalization.md` in the reviewed files so the documentation is part of the implementation; then revalidate the deliverable.
